jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Acme! We are building software that changes the world & delivers value to users.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of production experience with Node.js & TypeScript
  • Experience with high-throughput distributed systems
  • Strong SQL and database indexing knowledge

Benefits

  • 100% covered health, dental & vision
  • 401(k) matching
